name: io.github.aeko-intelligence/aeko-shop-mcp
title: AEKO Shop
description: Agentic storefront for aeko.shop — browse Korean long-tail brands, products, and contextual reviews (no auth needed), draft orders as a personal shopper, or manage profile and orders as a verified brand agent.

packageArguments.description: Server profile: 'personal' (shopper — anonymous catalog browsing, OAuth for carts/orders) or 'brand' (verified brand agent — profile + order management).

environmentVariables.name: AEKO_SHOP_AUTH_CODE
environmentVariables.description: One-time OAuth bootstrap code from the aeko.shop install flow. Safe to remove after the first successful exchange.

environmentVariables.name: BRAND_CONNECTION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: One-time, 5-minute token from aeko.shop/connect-brand that binds a brand install to a verified brand. Only needed on first brand install.

environmentVariables.name: AEKO_SHOP_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API origin (default https://api.aeko.shop). Only for staging.

environmentVariables.name: AEKO_SHOP_FRONTEND_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the consent-screen origin (default https://aeko.shop). Must match the API base deployment.
